author: wamozartk466
quote:
One of the best remakes of all time.  There are almost no things to complain about in this game.  The visuals are absolutely stunning and it's incredible what this game pulled off considering the hardware is not the strongest in the current generation.  The water physics are a marvel and the lighting and fog effects just look incredible.  It's hard to believe this is a Nintendo game.

But the number one thing that makes me love this game is watching my four year old Son smile and enjoy things like playing with the chickens, fishing, making music with the Ocarina, shooting Deku seeds, and exploring.  Seeing my child enjoy a game I loved growing up makes this an easy win for me.

This is a faithful remake that showed tremendous love and respect for the source material and I will cherish my physical foil copy for the rest of my life.  Well done, Nintendo.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: wamozartk466
quote:
I wanted to love it so badly as huge fan of this franchise.  But I have to be honest.  This is a travesty to the GTA franchise.  A complete departure from the tone and feel we've come to know and love from Rockstar Games.  

The pacing is god awful.  The voice acting is cheesy and poorly executed.  Especially Jason.  He just flat out ****.  Lucia is not much better.  The dialogue is hackneyed and eye-rolling.  It takes hours to even get to the point that you can commit the crime the game is NAMED AFTER.  You spend more time doing chores and taking care of your virtual girlfriend than doing any Grand Theft Autoing.  And you still can't steal nicer cars until you get a clone key much later in the playthrough.  This completely ruins the game for me off rip but this doesn't even begin to scratch the surface of the flaws this game is filled with.  I don't want to drone on too long so I will give a list of the reasons I would not recommend this game if you are a longtime fan of the franchise:

1. The game is 30 FPS sometimes.  Its not even locked. It's "targeting".  That's a joke in 2026.  Poor optimization is the only explanation.  If it's pushing the limits of the console, it's because it's a mess. Not because it's a marvel of software development.
2. Bugs.  This ties in with Point 1.  If this was optimized, there wouldn't be bugs. Unbelievable that they launched the game in this state.
3. Story ****. Straight up.  I hate it. It's so jarring going from any game in the series to this.
4. Characters **** and have very little personality or what personality they do have I can't stand (looking at you, Lucia). The voice acting is so bad.
5. Far too much focus on romance and mundane tasks and the missions are not that fun.  If I wanted to do romance and life sim, I'd play the Sims 4.
6. Loss of agency and the empathy/morality system.  Don't tell me how to play your game.  GTA was renowned for player agency.  Any design idea that reduces agency should've been mocked and scrapped.  I guess that's what happens when you put a bunch of soft leftists in the development team that can't handle their ideas being challenged and told no.
7. There are obvious Feminist undertones in this game throughout and Lucia **** and is representative of everything that I hate about modern feminist politics. Cry all you want, I don't want that crap in my game. Period.  I play games to get away from that nonsense.  I don't want any politics in my game, actually.  Not even politics I agree with.  This game is woke and that automatically makes me not like it.  Delete my review and avoid reality all you want. I don't care.  It's not going to make me agree with your opinion.
8. Protected NPCs that can't be killed.  Seriously.  I can't believe they thought this was okay at all.
9. Not one cutscene made me laugh.  Not one of these characters is funny or charming in anyway.  This is unprecedented for a Rockstar release.  Especially GTA.

In conclusion, this game is a joke and a slap in the face of the franchise. 

Shame on you Rockstar.  I will never buy another game of yours again!  I hope your studio goes out of business.
